text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: ...Hah!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Sakura Laurel climbs up a rope hanging 
from the second floor using only her arms.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: Hmph, hah... nngh!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
...This is training to build the 
latissimus dorsi, isn't it?
choice_data_list: You know a lot, don't you?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe. I did some research beforehand. 
It's supposed to be effective for training 
arm swing, too.
choice_data_list: There's another goal besides that, too.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
When Sakura Laurel runs, her form causes 
her to receive more impact from the ground 
than other Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
If I carelessly build up only leg 
strength, my upper body won't be able to 
handle the impact of landing.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
So, in order to train my entire upper 
body...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
...? But wouldn't the machines at the gym 
train the same muscle groups?
choice_data_list:
I guess the rest is to fuel my fighting 
spirit.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Fighting spirit...?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: ...Chiyo-chan! You came!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
No... wait, Laurel-san! The palm of your 
hand—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
! Ahaha... Umm, it's almost healed, so it 
doesn't even hurt, you know?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
When I first started this training, I 
couldn't climb it at all. I kept slipping 
over and over. ...I ended up with quite a 
few calluses, though.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Every time I fell, I climbed right back 
up, so my skin seems to have toughened up, 
too.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
...Maybe these hands were feeling 
frustrated, too.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
The skin's peeling and it looks unsightly, 
doesn't it? Sorry, let me put my gloves 
on—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: ...No, there is no need to hide it.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: —Your hands are cool.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Um, Laurel-san, Trainer-san. We're ready 
too. Bakushin O-san is out on the track as 
well.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Please let us help you all too.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
All right, let's make this joint run 2,400 
meters, just like the Japan Cup!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
I'll take the first 1200 meters! We'll run 
it as a relay, handing off to Chiyono 
O-san for the second half.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, let's do our best. Baku-chan, 
Chiyo-chan.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Treat this just like a real race and give 
it your all. Right now, I'm—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
To tell the truth, the race the other day 
is still taking a toll on my legs...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
—Because I'm way stronger than I used to 
be!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Yes!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And Sakura Laurel takes off running. 
Reaching for unprecedented growth, heading 
toward the Japan Cup—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, let's do our best. Baku-chan, 
Chiyo-chan.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: ...Yes!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Laurel-san, your arms, your legs, your 
entire body— every part of you is so 
sturdy now.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
We shall pour everything we have into this 
practice match as well.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah, please! I—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
To tell the truth, the race the other day 
is still taking a toll on my legs...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
—Because things are different from back 
then.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And Sakura Laurel and the others dashed 
forward. In order to make themselves 
stronger—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: Yeah, nice to meet—
choice_data_list: No, do you mind if we reverse the order?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Chowa?! Is that... really all right?!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
That means after running 1,200 meters, 
Laurel-san will immediately have to face 
me—the strongest sprinter—in a 1,200-meter 
race, but...
choice_data_list:
A tough challenge would be better for now, 
so...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
“...Indeed. Winning isn't my only goal for 
the Japan Cup, after all.”

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
If you want to make the strongest turn 
their head, you must run like no ordinary 
competitor.
choice_data_list:
With those legs, you can do it now, can't 
you, Laurel?

With those legs of yours, you can do it 
now, right, Laurel?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: ...Fufu. Of course!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: My body is—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
"No matter what trials come your way, you 
will surely overcome them. You will grow 
stronger."

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
If it's the me you've watched all this 
time...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I will win. No matter who my opponent 
is, I will be the one crossing the finish 
line first.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And Sakura Laurel and the others began 
their parallel training. If it's her, she 
should be able to reach beyond the realm 
of the strongest.
